# Component API

Components read only these keys. A scheme changes how they look by pointing a key at a different decision. The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-`.

| Key | What it controls | Default decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button/primary/background` | Primary button fill. | `color.action.primary` |
| `button/primary/background-hover` | Primary button fill on hover. | `color.action.primary-hover` |
| `button/primary/label` | Primary button label color. | `color.text.on-action` |
| `button/secondary/background` | Secondary button fill. | `color.action.secondary` |
| `button/secondary/background-hover` | Secondary button fill on hover. | `color.action.secondary-hover` |
| `button/secondary/label` | Secondary button label color. | `color.text.primary` |
| `button/secondary/border` | Secondary button border. | `color.border.strong` |
| `button/ghost/background-hover` | Ghost button fill on hover. | `color.surface.sunken` |
| `button/ghost/label` | Ghost button label color. | `color.text.link` |
| `button/height` | Button height. | `size.control.default` |
| `button/padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a button. | `space.inset.control-x` |
| `button/radius` | Button corner radius. | `radius.control` |
| `button/font-size` | Button label size. | `type.label.font-size` |
| `button/font-weight` | Button label weight. | `type.label.font-weight` |
| `button/focus-ring` | Focus ring color on any button. | `color.border.focus` |
| `input/background` | Input fill. | `color.surface.default` |
| `input/border` | Input border at rest. | `color.border.strong` |
| `input/border-focus` | Input border when focused. | `color.border.focus` |
| `input/text` | Typed text color. | `color.text.primary` |
| `input/placeholder` | Placeholder text color. | `color.text.muted` |
| `input/height` | Input height. | `size.control.default` |
| `input/padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside an input. | `space.inset.control-x` |
| `input/radius` | Input corner radius. | `radius.control` |
| `input/font-size` | Typed text size. | `type.body.font-size` |
| `control/checked` | Fill of a checked checkbox or an on switch. | `color.action.primary` |
| `control/track` | Track of an off switch. | `color.border.strong` |
| `control/thumb` | Switch thumb and checkmark color. | `color.surface.default` |
| `control/radius` | Checkbox corner radius. | `radius.badge` |
| `badge/radius` | Badge corner radius. | `radius.badge` |
| `badge/padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a badge. | `space.gap.tight` |
| `badge/font-size` | Badge label size. | `type.caption.font-size` |
| `badge/neutral/background` | Neutral badge fill. | `color.surface.sunken` |
| `badge/neutral/label` | Neutral badge label. | `color.text.secondary` |
| `badge/success/background` | Success badge fill. | `color.status.success-subtle` |
| `badge/success/label` | Success badge label. | `color.status.success` |
| `badge/warning/background` | Warning badge fill. | `color.status.warning-subtle` |
| `badge/warning/label` | Warning badge label. | `color.status.warning` |
| `badge/danger/background` | Danger badge fill. | `color.status.danger-subtle` |
| `badge/danger/label` | Danger badge label. | `color.status.danger` |
| `card/background` | Card fill. | `color.surface.default` |
| `card/border` | Card border. | `color.border.default` |
| `card/radius` | Card corner radius. | `radius.container` |
| `card/padding` | Padding inside a card. | `space.inset.container` |
| `card/shadow` | Card shadow. | `elevation.card` |
| `table/header-background` | Header row fill. | `color.surface.sunken` |
| `table/row-height` | Height of one data row. | `size.row` |
| `table/cell-padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a cell. | `space.inset.cell-x` |
| `table/row-border` | Line between rows. | `color.border.default` |
| `table/row-selected` | Fill of a selected row. | `color.surface.selected` |
| `table/font-size` | Cell text size. | `type.data.font-size` |
| `tabs/indicator` | Active tab indicator. | `color.action.primary` |
| `tabs/label` | Inactive tab label. | `color.text.secondary` |
| `tabs/label-active` | Active tab label. | `color.text.primary` |
| `overlay/background` | Fill of a dialog, menu or toast. | `color.surface.raised` |
| `overlay/radius` | Corner radius of overlays. | `radius.container` |
| `overlay/shadow` | Shadow of overlays. | `elevation.overlay` |
| `overlay/scrim` | Color that dims the page behind a dialog. | `color.surface.scrim` |
| `overlay/item-height` | Height of a menu item. | `size.control.default` |
| `tooltip/background` | Tooltip fill. | `color.surface.inverse` |
| `tooltip/label` | Tooltip text. | `color.text.inverse` |
| `transition/duration` | Duration of feedback transitions. | `motion.duration.feedback` |
| `transition/easing` | Easing of feedback transitions. | `motion.easing.standard` |
